item.title: Hubble 2.0.2
item.description:
# Hubble 2.0.2
- Modules can provide their own sidebar screens with settings, editable spreadsheets, read-only tables, and live status. Compatible module updates can add or change these screens without another Hubble application update. - Button Layout keeps the main sidebar visible. Draft layout edits stay in place when switching screens, and saved presets load when the layout editor opens. - Action menus use module-defined labels and groups, including the Ross OGP action types. Settings support live grouped choices and fractional number values. - Module settings and spreadsheet rows retain their identities and order through workspace export, import, and clipboard transfer. - Developer kit 1.1.0 includes the sidebar-page API guide and a working example.
This optional update installs Hubble and HubDash together and preserves existing workspaces, module selections, settings, and Companion connections. Ross OGP 1.0.1 is available separately through module updates.
